data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table the Syndicate shows a net adverse prioryear development of approximately 30.66 (USD millions) on underwriting years 2016-2020. This net strengthening was driven by increases on certain older years (notably 2017 and 2020) partly offset by favourable development on other older years (2016, 2018 and 2019). The notes attribute reserve movements generally to changes in claims experience, IBNR recalibration, claim inflation and legal/judicial and market factors; no specific named catastrophe events are quantified in the reserve movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: one-off occurrence, changes in market factors such as public attitude to claiming, economic conditions, claim inflation factors, as well as internal factors such as portfolio mix, policy conditions and claims handling procedures.
judicial decisions and government legislation affect the estimates.
The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by actuaries, on a best estimate basis, and reviewed annually by external consulting actuaries.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from liabilities (Claims outstanding) comparative column at 31/12/2021 (shown in the 2022 balance sheet). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross amount was provided in narrative; prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) as a fallback. The triangle was parsed from the notes and differences for underwriting years 2016-2020 were summed to produce the prior year development figure. LOB-specific reserve movements are not disclosed; lob_movements amounts are therefore null and directional attribution is indicative only. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). exact_reserve_text left blank because no single verbatim sentence explicitly stated the gross prior year movement.
